name: fact_selection
label: Fact selection
description: Picks one fact set every model in a group already knows, spread evenly across relations, so causal traces of those models are compared on the same facts. Launched from the Knowledge localisation page.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Fact set name
fields.note: the run name, and the folder the set is written to

fields.name: models
fields.label: Models
fields.note: comma-separated; the set keeps only facts all of them know

fields.name: formats
fields.label: Formats
fields.note: comma-separated; a fact must be known in every one (chat_* only by the instruct models)

fields.name: instruct_models
fields.label: Instruct models
fields.note: the models also held to the chat_* formats

fields.name: groups
fields.label: Groups
fields.note: 'name:model,model;...': one set per group from the facts its models share. Empty: one set over all models.

options.label: all records (tracing only: it locates, it does not pick a setting)

fields.name: max_candidates
fields.label: Candidates to score
fields.note: sample at most this many facts, evenly across relations/domains, before scoring (0 = all)

fields.name: known_check
fields.label: Known-fact check
fields.note: generate: the model answers and must say an accepted answer; what it writes first becomes the lead-in, and the answer is traced where the model gives it. first_token: the answer's first token must be the very next token (the original test)

options.label: the model answers, the answer must appear (generate)
the next token must be the answer (first_token)

fields.name: judge
fields.label: Judge
fields.note: asked only about answers that do not contain an accepted answer: it may accept an equivalent (NYC for New York City). local loads Qwen3-4B-Instruct on the job's own GPU; ollama runs a quantised model through Ollama; api uses evaluation.local.json

fields.name: judge_model
fields.label: Judge model
fields.note: empty: qwen3-4b-instruct-2507 for local, qwen3:4b-instruct for Ollama, the configured model for the API
